title: Critical TechWorks is excluded as a single-vertical automotive shop with no stack on record
content:
Critical TechWorks' row records one vertical, automotive, with the researcher's own emphasis on "only", and a tool field of "n/a". Everything else is the standard carry-over: a provisional v2 tail entry, rescored mechanically on size and slot occupancy, never scored on v3.

A single vertical constrains what could be built with the firm. Any demo would be tied to one sector's processes and would carry no reuse into the rest of the pipeline, which is a real cost when the point of a demo is to be shown twice. With no platform record, the slot-occupancy half of the rescore had nothing to work on, so the tier rests on scale and vertical narrowness.

The flag nonetheless still asks for an OSS-portfolio screen before acting, which makes this exclusion provisional in the same breath as it is stated — the same pattern as the other do-not-pitch rows carried over from v2.
